content:
maria: Heads-up — we need quota increases in ap-southeast-1 for an upcoming ML training run. Primary asks: EBS gp3 IOPS target 80k for a short burst window, snapshot API rate to 120/min, and GPU instance quota bump for 24 p4d-style instances. Also need an extra 200 ENI attachments and a NAT gateway throughput bump for cross-subnet traffic. We’re planning to run the job Tue morning (UTC).

arun: Do we have a support case open already? Need exact numbers for provider form.

maria: Opened case with cloud: CASE-ACCT-981234 (support portal). I filled in rough numbers but they want account IDs and justification. Justification: 48h training job for model finetune, will create/release volumes and snapshots in that window, burst IO required to hit target throughput.

lee: Can we avoid snapshot spike by using streaming checkpoint to S3 in parallel? That might reduce snapshot rate requirements.

maria: We evaluated that. Two problems: (1) KMS policy for cross-account export is stricter in ap-southeast-1, adding delay; (2) the training infra expects EBS-volume-level quick-restore snapshots for fast restart — S3 + restore would add ~30-45m per restart which we can't tolerate.

priya: For costs — bumping EBS IOPS quota to 80k for that region will likely increase burst billing. Estimate ~$3.5k extra for the 48h run (storage + snapshot API ops + short GPU reserved churn). Confirmed with finance.

sam: For GPU quota: are we requesting specific family (p4d vs g5)? cloud support usually needs exact SKU names.

maria: Asking for 24 p4dn.24xlarge equivalents (or nearest provider SKU), plus a fallback of 40 g5-like smaller instances if they can't provide all p4d. Also requested a temporary elastic IP / NAT quota increase for outbound egress.

quota-bot: Reminder: include the following in provider request: billing owner, account IDs (infra-prod-001, ml-training-003), contact phone, and expected start/end timestamps.

arun: I'll prepare a short justification doc. Maria — can you drop the account IDs and the exact start/end times? Also need a runbook: what do we do if they deny the quota?

maria: Account IDs: infra-prod-001, ml-training-003. Planned start: 2026-04-14T02:00:00Z. Planned end: 2026-04-16T02:00:00Z. Runbook if denied: 1) fallback to staged checkpoints (longer restore time), 2) split job into 2 smaller parallel runs over two days to stay under IOPS/snapshot limits, 3) deploy temporary dedicated volume servers in eu-west-1 and cross-region copy (high latency) as last resort.

lee: Can cloud-eng help with pre-approved tagging and billing contacts so support escalations go faster? Also confirm KMS key alias to use for snapshots to avoid extra approval.

cloud-eng: We can pre-provide the KMS alias: alias/redwood-apac-snaps. Also confirmed we have a support contract level that includes expedited quota requests — we should route through account rep. I'll open an escalation with our AM and ask for 48-72h turnaround.

priya: Finance approves the temporary spend. Please mark the cost center tag: cc:ml-experiments and enable hourly spend alerts > $2k/day.

sam: Small ask — can we request snapshot lifecycle policy to tier older snaps to cold storage automatically after 2 days? That reduces snapshot count and long-term cost.

maria: Added that to the case: lifecycle transition to cold storage after 48h, retention 30d. If provider can't do it at snapshot level, we will implement S3 copy + lifecycle.

arun: I'll draft the provider form now and post it here for review. If cloud-eng can ping our AM that will help.

cloud-eng: AM pinged, escalated support case CASE-ACCT-981234 -> priority P2. Requested provisional quota until full review. Please add any missing details to the case comments.

maria: Thanks — please also note we need outcome by 2026-04-12 EOD UTC to avoid rescheduling.

priya: Noted. finance will approve immediate spend if outcome confirmed.

arun: Draft posted: 
```
Project: ML finetune (ml-training-003)
Requested quotas: EBS gp3 IOPS 80,000 (burst temp), Snapshot rate 120/min, GPU p4d instances 24 (or 40 g5 fallback), ENI attachments +200, NAT throughput bump to 10Gbps.
Justification: 48h high-throughput training requiring fast restore and burst IO for checkpointing. Start 2026-04-14T02:00:00Z, end 2026-04-16T02:00:00Z. Contact: maria@redwood.com, +1-555-0199.
```

lee: LGTM. Add a line: we will delete temporary volumes within 48h of job completion and provide deletion confirmation to support.

arun: Added. Submitting now. Will update thread with provider case updates and any provisional quotas.

maria: Appreciate it. If anyone has a faster workaround suggest now, otherwise hold for escalation updates.
